Bacon-flavored Dog Biscuits
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




5 cups whole wheat flour
1 cup milk
2 eggs
10 tablespoons vegetable oil or bacon fat
1 tablespoon onion or garlic powder
1/2 cup cold water
vegetable oil or bacon fat, to grease sheet

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients well. Pinch off pieces of the dough and roll them into two-inch balls.Put them on a greased cookie sheet. 2 Bake them at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes. Let them cool, then store in an airtight container.

About


Give the dog a (bacon-flavored) bone
